errors.evidence: The agent's plan is based on the assumption that the search agent will directly provide the website URL and banner image. This is an overestimation of the search agent's capabilities and a potential misinterpretation of its output.
errors.description: The agent assumes the search agent will directly provide the website URL and banner image, which is not guaranteed and requires further processing.
